children: Mumbai: IndiGo and Akasa Air have extended flight cancellations to Saudi Arabia amid continuing security concerns in the Middle East, with IndiGo keeping its Riyadh services suspended until October 31 and flights to three other Saudi cities cancelled until October 27.

The extensions affect services to Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam and Madinah, key destinations for Indian travellers and workers. The disruptions come amid attacks on Saudi targets, raising concerns over the safety of airport operations and prompting airlines to reassess their schedules.

title: IndiGo and Akasa Extend Saudi Flight Cancellations
